plugins.name: bag-submission
plugins.description: Package a prompt, skill, or workflow into a finished Bag Submission post for The AI Clinicians' Medical Bag, with the community's three rules enforced and a patient-data-free check. Also saves the entry as a markdown file

plugins.name: em-code-advisor
plugins.description: Assign the correct E/M code from a clinical note and justify it element by element against the 2021/2023 CPT MDM grid and time thresholds, across office, inpatient, observation, ED, nursing facility, and home settings. Codes only what the documentation supports and returns gaps as provider queries

plugins.name: phi-redactor
plugins.description: De-identify PHI in clinical text and documents entirely on the local machine, with no network call at redaction time. Reads .txt, .md, .pdf, .docx, .xlsx, and .pptx, and offers a reversible mode so text can be de-identified, processed elsewhere, then restored. Requires a one-time model download
